title: Conversion Table (Fahrenheit to Celsius)
code:
lower = 0
upper = 300
step = 20

fahr = lower    
while fahr < upper:
    celsius = (5.0 / 9.0) * (fahr - 32.0);
    print (fahr, "F =", celsius, "C")
    fahr += step

lines.explanation: Assigning the lower bound value to the variable 'lower'
Assigning the upper bound value to the variable 'upper'
Defining the step size of the conversion table. The variable 'step' is used for this purpose. In this case we define the step size to be 20
This statement basically assigns the value of variable 'lower' to the variable 'fahr'
Initializing the 'while' loop and setting the condition so that it iterates till the value of 'fahr' is less than the value of 'upper' (less than 300)
This is the conversion formula to convert the temperature from Fahrenheit to Celsius
Incrementing the value of Fahrenheit by step size (20)
